# PasswordStrengthMeter

**Class:** `UltraCanvasPasswordStrengthMeter` · **Group:** [Text entry](../Groups/Text-entry.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasPasswordStrengthMeter.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasPasswordStrengthMeter.h) · `#include "UltraCanvasPasswordStrengthMeter.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

Password quality feedback

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasPasswordStrengthMeter> CreatePasswordStrengthMeter( const std::string& id, float x, float y, float w, float h, StrengthMeterStyle style = StrengthMeterStyle::Bar);
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasPasswordStrengthMeter> CreateBarStrengthMeter( const std::string& id, float x, float y, float w, float h = 20);
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasPasswordStrengthMeter> CreateCircularStrengthMeter( const std::string& id, float x, float y, float size = 80);
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasPasswordStrengthMeter(const std::string& id, float x, float y, float w, float h);
UltraCanvasPasswordStrengthMeter(const std::string& id, float w, float h);
explicit UltraCanvasPasswordStrengthMeter(const std::string& id);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).
